data.name: Fayaaz
data.gender_notes: Fayaaz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root fa'a, meaning 'to conquer' or 'to overcome'. In Islamic context, Fayaaz signifies a victorious and strong believer who overcomes all obstacles and challenges in his life. This name is mentioned in Hadith as the name of a Companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name Fayaaz carries the meaning “Victorious, Conqueror” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fayaaz usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, conqueror and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the spirit of perseverance and triumph over adversity.
data.etymology: Fayaaz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, Conqueror.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fayaaz total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: فياض
in_arabic.meaning: الفياض اسم مشتق من الفعل فياض، يعني كثيرة العطاء
in_arabic.long_meaning: الفياض اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل فياض الذي يعني كثيرة العطاء، السخي، الجواد. ورد في القرآن الكريم ذكر الفعل فياض في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: ﴿وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُعْمَرُونَ بِهِ﴾، وقد وردت هذه الآية في سورة الأنعام. يعتبر اسم فياض من الأسماء ذات الأهمية الكبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرمز إلى الكرم والسخاء

in_urdu.name: فیاض
in_urdu.meaning: فیاض کا مطلب ہے بہت زیادہ دینے والا، سخی، جواد
in_urdu.long_meaning: فیاض ایک مذکر نام ہے جس کی اصل عربی ہے۔ یہ نام فعل فیاض سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے بہت زیادہ دینے والا، سخی، جواد۔ اسلامی تقویم میں اس نام کی اہمیت بہت زیادہ ہے کیونکہ یہ کرم اور سخاوت کی علامت ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیا میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعہ اس نام کا استعمال تاریخی و ثقافتی لحاظ سے اہم رہا ہے

in_hindi.name: फायाज़
in_hindi.meaning: फायाज़ का अर्थ है बहुत देने वाला, उदार, दयालु
in_hindi.long_meaning: फायाज़ एक पुरुष नाम है जिसकी उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है। यह नाम क्रिया फायाज़ से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है बहुत देने वाला, उदार, दयालु। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इस नाम का उपयोग पारंपरिक और सांस्कृतिक दृष्टिकोण से महत्वपूर्ण रहा है। यह नाम उदारता और दयालुता का प्रतीक है

in_pashto.name: فیاض
in_pashto.meaning: فیاض د ډیرو ورکونکي، سخي، جواد معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: فیاض یو مذکر نوم دی چې په اصل کې عربي دی. دا نوم د فياض فعل څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې ډیرو ورکونکي، سخي، جواد دي. په افغان او پښتون دود کې دې نوم ته لوی اهميت ورکړل شوی دی ځکه چې سخاوت او کرم ته اشاره کوي

in_english.name: Fayaaz
in_english.meaning: Fayaaz means abundantly giving, generous, and charitable
in_english.long_meaning: Fayaaz is a masculine given name of Arabic origin. It is derived from the Arabic verb 'fayaaza', which means to give abundantly, to be generous. The name Fayaaz holds significant importance in Islamic tradition as it symbolizes generosity, charity, and kindness. Etymologically, it relates to the Arabic root 'f-y-z', which conveys the idea of abundance and liberality. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting the value of being open-handed and charitable. The personality traits associated with the name Fayaaz include being generous, kind-hearted, and philanthropic. In modern usage, Fayaaz remains a popular name among Muslim families worldwide, embodying the virtues of compassion and munificence

data.cultural_impact: The name Fayaaz holds a significant cultural impact as it is a mournful reminder of an exemplary companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The Companion Fayaaz bin Musnaad, during the Battle of Uhud, picked up the standard of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) when it was dropped and continued leading the Muslim army despite being injured multiple times. Fayaaz's bravery, resolve, and determination to ensure the Muslim victory at Uhud have been passed down through generations and remain an inspiring tale of courage and sacrifice.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Fayaaz's name highlights the importance of perseverance, determination, and faith in God. As Muslims, we are all called upon to face various challenges and obstacles throughout our lives. Fayaaz's example encourages us to embrace these challenges with courage and strength, trusting in God's plan and seeking His guidance to overcome them. Furthermore, Fayaaz's name serves as a reminder of the crucial role each individual plays in contributing to the collective Muslim community, embodying the ideal of a brave and steadfast believer.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Abi Shaybah in his 'Al-Musannaf' recorded that there was a man named Fayaaz, who was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). He was a well-known poet and a skilled archer. Fayaaz participated in the Battle of Uhud where he was martyred.
historical_references.time_period: 624-656 AD (Year of Prophethood to the First Caliphate)

historical_references.reference: Al-Bukhari and Muslim in their 'Sahih' collections recorded a Hadith narrated by Anas bin Malik, where the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) mentioned Fayaaz as one of the Ansar who treated him with utmost kindness when he (pbuh) immigrated to Medina. Fayaaz provided the Prophet (pbuh) with a house to stay in and looked after him.
historical_references.time_period: 622-632 AD (Migration to Medina to the Prophet's Farewell Pilgrimage)
historical_references.context: Early Islamic History and Prophet's Companions
